gen.title: How the endoplasmic reticulum and Golgi apparatus work together

links.quote: The Golgi apparatus packages molecules processed by the endoplasmic reticulum to be transported out of the cell.
The endoplasmic reticulum also transports these molecules to their specific destinations either inside or outside the cell.
These organelles can float freely in the cytoplasm or be connected to the endoplasmic reticulum (see above).
